verification_repair.failure: The gate compared its registered four analysis phases to the verifier's complete five-phase inventory, which additionally contains the intentionally unused step-0 snapshot.
verification_repair.repair: Compare the registered 2373/4746/7119/9489 subset against the corresponding verified inventory entries.

scientific_question: Does adding directed-product chart coordinates only in late c_fc layers 8-11 recover the same-run task tangent at the measured 15/20TPP capacity failure without disrupting the 10TPP phase?
theory_chain: Same-run activation analysis localizes the first frozen failure to late-band pre-GELU capacity at 15TPP.
The c_fc/c_proj factorial interaction is strongly beneficial, so freezing, transplanting, or independently replacing either matrix is rejected.
The Mapping Networks LWT principle permits layer-specific chart allocation, while broad all-layer widening is not supported by the measured deficit.

Prior zero-update capacity evidence shows the six-stage 176-coefficient family has more tangent capacity than the production six-stage 132-coefficient family; this gate tests whether that advantage is phase-local, task-functional, and specific to task-directed connectivity.

protocol.direction: scheduled-LR stateless Muon polar descent plus configured weight decay; historical momentum and error-feedback state are unavailable and explicitly excluded
protocol.random_control: same 176 coordinates in late layers with deterministic task-independent no-self unique affine-cycle connectivity; coefficients remain least-squares fitted
protocol.execution: direct foreground polling through process exit; expected under five minutes

decision_rule.primary_metric: late-band positive-line recovery of one fit-window chart update against both fit and disjoint holdout stateless-Muon task directions
decision_rule.functional_rule: At both 15TPP and 20TPP, the 95% paired upper bound versus the current chart must be at most +0.001 CE, and at least one phase mean must improve by 0.0005 CE.
decision_rule.pass: Promote only per-layer schedule implementation and an exact-config MFU preflight; training remains separately blocked.
decision_rule.reject: Reject late-only coordinate widening in this directed-product topology; do not sweep width, radius, modulation, or loss coefficients from this result.

interpretation_boundaries: This is a same-run local tangent and one-step functional audit, not an estimate of global manifold dimension.
Stateless Muon omits unavailable historical momentum and error-feedback residuals, so the audit cannot be called exact optimizer replay.
A passing result supports layer-wise coordinate allocation only; it does not validate paper modulation or Mapping Loss.
